The terminal point appears once with a minus sign inside the last within-potential difference and once with a plus sign in the endpoint gap. Their cancellation explains why the scored regret does not depend on an unplayed endpoint.

Proof idea

The cumulative-loss parts telescope to sum_{t<T}loss_t(y_t)-H_T(z). Adding the final comparator regularizer minus the initial played regularizer and the retained G_(T-1)(z)-G_(T-1)(u) leaves exactly the regret. This is the mathematical cancellation argument, not a claimed implementation route.
